entrypoint_files.description: Core chat orchestration service - singleton per chat instance. Manages full conversation lifecycle including tool execution loop, streaming, and token counting.

key_methods.name: sendMessage
key_methods.description: Main entry: sends user message, processes stream, handles tool invocations

key_methods.name: processStreamCompletion
key_methods.description: Post-stream processing: extracts tool calls, dispatches execution

key_methods.name: handleToolInvocations
key_methods.description: Handles multiple tool invocations from a single AI response

key_methods.name: processToolResults
key_methods.description: Feeds tool results back to AI for next turn (agentic loop)

agent_loop_classes.loop_mechanism: Implicit agentic loop via processToolResults() -> AIService.sendMessage() recursion
agent_loop_classes.description: After AI responds with tool calls, results are collected and fed back into the conversation. There is no explicit max_iterations in the chat loop; it continues until the AI responds without tool calls.
Vision-language agent for Android UI automation. Uses screenshot + action loop up to maxSteps (default 20).

key_methods.name: run
key_methods.description: Main agent loop entry - sends task+systemPrompt, iterates _executeStep until finished or maxSteps

key_methods.name: _executeStep
key_methods.description: Single agent step: screenshot -> AI -> parse action -> execute via ActionHandler

key_methods.name: parseAgentAction
key_methods.description: Parses do(action=...) and finish(message=...) from AI response

key_methods.name: reset
key_methods.description: Clears agent context history and step counter

agent_loop_classes.description: Executes parsed PhoneAgent actions. Contains executeAgentAction() with Launch/Tap/Type/Swipe/Back/Home/Wait/Take_over handlers.

key_methods.name: executeAgentAction
key_methods.description: Dispatches parsed action to implementation (uses Shower virtual display or tool layer)

key_methods.name: captureScreenshotForAgent
key_methods.description: Captures screenshot via Shower WS or bitmap fallback

key_methods.name: getSystemPrompt
key_methods.description: Generates complete system prompt with tool descriptions, workspace guidelines, package system info

key_methods.name: getSystemPromptWithCustomPrompts
key_methods.description: Extended version with hook dispatch for custom prompt composition

templates.name: SUBTASK_AGENT_PROMPT_TEMPLATE
templates.description: Template for subtask agents (no memory, no emotion)

system_prompt_builders.description: Defines structured tool descriptions (ToolPrompt with ToolParameterSchema) organized by category for system prompt inclusion
Internal tool prompt generation for dynamic tool visibility and capability-based tool inclusion

context_managers.description: Per-conversation execution context holding conversationHistory, streamBuffer, roundManager, eventChannel, isConversationActive flag
Thread-local runtime context for tool execution (callerCardId, toolExposureMode)

tool_selection_logic.description: Tool selection based on role card access control, CLI mode exposure, and character card permissions
Auto-activates package when tool name looks like 'package:toolName', supporting dynamic tool resolution

max_iterations.chat_loop: No explicit limit - continues until AI responds without tool calls

streaming_support.mechanism: AIService.sendMessage returns Stream<String>; EnhancedAIService processes chunks via TextStreamEventCarrier with savepoint/rollback revision tracking

cancellation_support.mechanism: coroutine Job tracking via PhoneAgentJobRegistry; cancelConversation() in EnhancedAIService; CancellationException handling throughout

ToolResultData.description: Sealed class with variants: BooleanResultData, StringResultData, SleepResultData, ADBResultData, DirectoryListingData, FileContentData, FileApplyResultData, BinaryFileContentData, FileExistsData, FileInfoData, FileOperationData, FilePartContentData, FindFilesResultData, GrepResultData, AppListData, etc.
